title: Causality-Inspired Single-Source Domain Generalization for Medical Image Segmentation (GIN + IPA)
mechanism: Random shallow conv nets re-map intensity and texture each step (GIN); two GIN views are blended with a smooth random spatial map (IPA) so neighbouring regions get independent appearance, removing confounder-to-label shortcuts; KL consistency between views.
adaptation: 1-channel EL fits directly (built for gray MRI/CT). Use 1x1 or 3x3 kernels and cap blend alpha so 1-2 px cracks are not blurred. IPA lattice of 8 to 16 cells per 512 px so streak-sized regions (scuff analogue) get their own appearance. No geometric change, so jittered crack labels stay aligned. Stack on house label-safe aug.
min_experiment: PF + GIN/IPA (p=0.5) vs PF, 3 seeds. Metric E1 crack relF1@2 and recall; guard test-clean-49 crack IoU. Kill if E1 relF1@2 gain < +0.03 or test crack IoU drops > 0.01. Selection on val/F51 only.
evidence: R: consistent Dice gains over ERM, RandConv, AdvBias, MixStyle on CT->MRI abdominal, bSSFP->LGE cardiac and cross-site prostate; ablation 4 layers / 2 hidden channels best (86.04 avg Dice abdominal without IPA). Small medical training sets.
prior_overlap: none: BRIEF s5 aug was flips/rot90/brightness/contrast only; intensity normalisation at inference failed but that is test-time, not train-time randomisation.

alt_notes.adaptation: 1-channel GIN with 1x1/3x3 kernels keeps 1-2 px crack geometry so labels stay valid; IPA masks use structural classes (ribbons, border, frame_edge, sp_multi grain) so their appearance cannot serve as a crack/inactive cue; aimed at E1 and weak BMRK/CSIR sources.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house + GIN (p=0.5) + IPA on structural classes, also on PF. Baselines: house and PF. Metrics: E1 crack relF1@2, E1 inactive IoU, test mIoU_rob. Kill: E1 relF1@2 < +0.03 and E1 inactive IoU < +0.03 on PF arm, or test mIoU_rob drop > 0.01.

alt_notes.adaptation: 1-channel GIN with 4 layers and 2 hidden channels; at least 2 layers with 1x1 kernels so 1 to 2 px cracks survive; renormalise intensity. The IPA blend map gives low-frequency, spatially varying contrast that looks like scuff streaks and uneven EL. Labels unchanged. Replaces brightness/contrast-only augmentation.
alt_notes.min_experiment: PF+GIN-IPA (p 0.5) vs PF, 5 seeds. Metrics: E1 crack relF1@2 and relR@2, E1 inactive IoU; guard test clean-49 crack IoU. Kill: E1 relF1@2 gain < +0.03 or test crack IoU drop > 0.01.

alt_notes.adaptation: Apply GIN (3x3 kernels, 1 channel) with p=0.5 on top of label-safe augmentation; geometry is untouched so 1 to 2 px labels stay valid. IPA regions = structural classes (busbar, ribbon, border, padding) so their appearance cannot act as a crack or source cue. Aims at E1 and weak sources (BMRK, CSIR).
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house + GIN-IPA, 5 seeds; also PF + GIN-IPA. Baseline: house and PF. Metrics: E1 crack relF1@2, E1 inactive IoU, test mIoU_rob. Kill: E1 relF1@2 < +0.03 and E1 inactive IoU < +0.03 vs PF.
